traveling_merchant.title: A Traveling Merchant
traveling_merchant.description: A covered cart waits at the roadside. The merchant lifts a lantern and spreads a small selection of goods across the tailgate.

roadside_shrine.title: A Roadside Shrine
roadside_shrine.description: A weathered stone shrine stands beside the road. Its bowl still holds clear water, and old carvings promise safe passage.

stranded_wagon.title: A Stranded Wagon
stranded_wagon.description: A wagon lies tilted in the ditch, its axle cracked. A locked strongbox is still wedged beneath the driver's bench.

wounded_traveler.title: A Wounded Traveler
wounded_traveler.description: A traveller sits against a milestone, clutching a bloodied cloak. They raise a hand when they see you.

ambush.title: An Ambush
ambush.description: Figures move in the brush beside the road.
